topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I woke up to the delightful surprise of a vase filled with sunflowers and tulips by the window, their colors vibrant and their scent a gentle morning kiss. No card was tucked among the leaves or petals, but I didn’t need words to feel the warmth of the gesture. I imagine the hands that selected each stem with care, the smile that accompanied the thought of how these blooms would brighten my day. I walked over, fingers brushing lightly over the soft petals, and felt a peaceful contentment. Whoever sent these, they knew just what I needed, even if I never find out who it was. Today, I’ll carry the joy these flowers bring like a secret, a sweet and silent knowing in my heart.
